editorial:
Imagine you are filming a cute vlog of your big move across the country, planning a secret proposal to the love of your life. That is exactly where you start with David and his fiancé. It feels like a sweet, romantic trip at first, but the vibe changes fast when David notices something creepy in the background of his videos. You will feel that growing sense of dread as you realize a dangerous stranger has been watching them the whole time. It turns a happy life event into a scary game of cat and mouse that keeps you guessing about who is actually behind the camera.

The pacing is pretty quick, and the tension builds up well enough to keep you on the edge of your seat. While some of the plot points feel a bit familiar, the acting is solid and makes the danger feel real. If you enjoy movies about stalkers and unexpected twists, you should definitely give this one a try. It is a great pick for a rainy weekend.
endingExplained: The big twist reveals that the stalker is actually someone from David's past who has been obsessed with him. After a tense final showdown in the house, the stalker tries to kill the couple. However, David and his fiancé manage to fight back and outsmart the killer. The movie ends with the police arriving to take the stalker away, finally giving the couple the peace and safety they need to start their new life together.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves suspenseful movies about obsessed strangers.
